case_resolution_contract.governance_status: RUO — research use only; not clinical decision support
case_resolution_contract.one_sentence: Tumor Board translates CrisPRO's research intelligence into a traceable case workspace that organizes what the molecular profile supports, which mechanism-aligned options and trials should be investigated, what evidence applies, and what remains uncertain.

required: Molecular profile (variants, structural events, expression signature where available)
input_contract.governance: Any protected health information handling is out of scope for the public surface; enterprise deployments include the governance layer.

sections.content: Named pathways/MoA active or perturbed in the profile.
SL candidates, dependency signals, escape routes.
Therapeutic mechanisms aligned to the biology; framed as research exploration.
Every claim tagged with source and evidence tier.
What the profile does NOT tell us; where confidence is low.
Quarantine notes; RUO reminder; wet-lab/clinical work remaining.

prohibited_framing: Responder prediction for the individual patient.

shared_layer_components.tumor_board_use: Candidate dependency exploration for the individual profile.
Optional research annotation on the biology map.
Research safety flag on options exploration.

shared_layer_components.interception_use: Bounds on product claims (POC vs CFD, AF3 gates).
shared_layer_components.tumor_board_use: Bounds on case-output framing (research, not clinical).

shared_layer_matrix.invariant: A vulnerability, mechanism, escape route, or trial that surfaces in one product surfaces in the others the same way — pulled from the same layer. Product surfaces differ in the customer decision they scope.
